text:
maria-support: heads up — multiple customers hitting 5xx on the inference API where they should be seeing 429s. Started ~10:12 PST. ticket C-9876. examples attached.
charlie-sre: thanks, can you paste one raw response (headers + status) and the req id? region?
maria-support: us-west. sample from customer (sanitized):
```
HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
Date: Tue, 12 Mar 2025 17:12:33 GMT
x-redwood-request-id: req_0a1b2c3d4e
x-upstream-service: quota-orch
x-upstream-status: 504
x-rate-limit-reason: quota-store-timeout
content-type: application/json

{"error":"upstream_timeout","detail":"quota-orch timeout when checking token"}
```
charlie-sre: ok that x-upstream-status 504 + quota-store-timeout looks like quota-orch timed out to its backing store. Dina, any idea why a quota dependency timeout would bubble as 5xx instead of mapping to 429?
dina-eng: quick summary from tracing: request hits api-gateway -> rateboard (quota-orch) -> quota-store (redis cluster). quota-orch waits for quota-store and on timeout returns a 504 to the gateway. Gateway currently treats any upstream 5xx as a platform 5xx and surfaces that to client. We never had conservative fallback for quota-store timeouts, so no 429 mapping.
thom-prod: several paying customers affected, severity P1 for now. What's repro? can we reproduce in staging?
maria-support: I reproduced locally with customer token, short timeouts. curl below returns 502 consistently for me:
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-cust" -H "Region: us-west" -d '{"model":"rwd-small","input":"hi"}' https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate --connect-timeout 1 --max-time 5
```
quota-bot: incident created: INC-12345 (auto). Notifying oncall.
dina-eng: repro steps for eng: set QUOTA_STORE_TIMEOUT=50ms in staging for quota-orch and hit /v1/generate with a known-hot token. You should see quota-orch log line: `quota-store: request timed out after 50ms` then quota-orch emits 504 and gateway turns into 502/504 to client.
charlie-sre: logs? can you dump quota-orch excerpt?
dina-eng: pasted small log snippet from staging:
```
2025-03-12T17:10:12.345Z quota-orch INFO req=req_0a1b2c4x checking token for uid=acct_123
2025-03-12T17:10:12.396Z quota-orch WARN req=req_0a1b2c4x quota-store timeout after=51ms srv=redis-cluster node=10.2.4.5
2025-03-12T17:10:12.397Z quota-orch ERROR req=req_0a1b2c4x returning=504 reason=quota-store-timeout
```
charlie-sre: that matches. Problem: gateway should classify this as a rate-limit decision (429) when quota-orch can't contact store? Might be risky to always 429 on timeouts. What's the desired behavior?
dina-eng: two options: (A) conservative fail-closed: if quota-orch can't verify and token exists, deny with 429 to avoid uncontrolled bursts; (B) fail-open: allow through as 200 which is risky for quota enforcement. For hosted inference we prefer (A). We can implement mapping: if quota-orch returns 504 with reason "quota-store-timeout" and quota-orch flag `verified_missing==false`, gateway should convert to 429. This is a small gateway shim (~30 LOC) and a feature flag.
thom-prod: implement option A for public hosted for now. Rollout plan?
dina-eng: I opened PR #8342 with the gateway mapping and a feature flag `rate_fallback_on_quota_timeouts=true`. Will deploy to staging now. Patch also adds metric `quota_timeout_mapped_to_429` and unit tests.
charlie-sre: great — can you also add alerting: if `quota_timeout_mapped_to_429` > 0.1% of requests then escalate?
dina-eng: will add. also plan to restart quota-orch pool nodes one-by-one to clear redis connection issues asap (hotfix).
maria-support: CS notified customers with temporary mitigation (rate-limit semantics restored as 429). Will update tickets C-9876, C-9877, C-9881.
thom-prod: schedule postmortem once stabilized. thanks all. :thumbsup:
maria-support: after staging verification, please tag me for prod rollout.
dina-eng: staging looks good. rolling deploy to prod with feature flag off by default, enabling only for hosted-public route. rolling 50% -> 100% if metrics look good. ETA 30m.
charlie-sre: i'll monitor 5xx spikes and the new metric, will report back in 10m.
maria-support: thanks — I'll update support channel and customer threads.
